explainer_content.short_definition: Streaming-era pop whose hooks, personas, and release cycles are amplified by platforms and internet fandom.
explainer_content.history_capsule: Olivia Rodrigo, Dua Lipa, Charli XCX, Doja Cat, Sabrina Carpenter, and related artists show how pop circulation changed when clips and discourse became part of discovery.
explainer_content.why_it_mattered: It explains why a short bridge, lyric caption, or personality meme can become the way listeners first meet a song.
explainer_content.what_made_it_distinct: The song still has to work, but its smallest repeatable parts matter more than in earlier radio monocultures.
